_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Contract Status Report
summary: Contract Status Report provides the progress of work performed and the status of all program assigned tasks, cost and information and management of existing or potential problem areas.
use_relationship:
Contract Status Report provides the progress of work performed and the status of all program assigned tasks, cost and information and management of existing or potential problem areas.

This Data Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.

This DID supersedes DI-MGMT-81928.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The Contract Status Report shall be in a format similar to that of Figures 1, 2, and 3 of this DID.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content:
The report shall contain a cover sheet identifying the following:
a. Title of the report
b. Contractor's name and address
c. Contract Number
d. Date of report and period by the report
e. Data Item Number listed on the CDRL DD FORM 1423-1

children.title: Results positive and negative
children.content: The report shall include results positive and negative related to previously identified problem areas, with conclusions and recommendations.

children.title: Significant changes to the Contract's organization
children.content: The Report shall include an significant changes to the Contract's organization, method of operation, and the project management network.

children.title: Problem areas affecting cost elements
children.content:
The report shall identify problem areas affecting cost elements, technical or scheduling elements, and shall in background and any recommendations for solutions beyond the scope of the contract for the following items:
a. Funding issues
(1) Shortfalls
(2) Overfunding
b. Task Area Issues

children.title: Cost curves
children.content: The report shall contain cost curves showing actual projected conditions throughout the contract, any cost incurred for the reporting period and total contractual expenditures as of the reporting date.

children.title: Man-hours expended
children.content:
The report shall contain Man-hours expended for the reporting period and cumulatively for the contract for the following areas:
a. Trip(s) outside the local area, site visited and purpose
b. Contract schedule status
c. Plans for activities during the following reporting period
d. Name and telephone number of signer of the report
e. Appendixes for any necessary tables, references, photographs, illustrations, and charts

children.title: Information specified in Figures 1, 2, and 3
children.content: The report shall contain all of the information specified in Figures 1, 2, and 3, and shall identify employee movement, color coded and highlighted in the comments column.

children.title: The report shall identify the following
children.content:
a. Title i.e.: Professional Support Services for the Program Executive Office (PEO) Integrated Warfare System (IWS)
b. Contract Number
c. CLIN Number
d. Latest Contract Modification (# and Date)
e. Period of Performance
f. Reporting Period
g. Contractor's POC
h. Government PM
i. Government COR

children.title: Financial/Labor Data
children.content:
The report shall also include the following:
a. Contract Value
b. Funded to date
c. Cost of work performed during period (period to be defined as CY)
d. Planned travel for the upcoming Calendar Month to include location, number of contractor personnel and purpose
e. Actual: Monthly Hours Burned by each contractor/employee
f. Invoice Date/Amount/Number

preparation_instructions.title: Summary
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall contain a summary by Project, Work Area and Technical Instruction.

children.title: A Description of the progress made
children.content: during the reporting period, the value-added tasks performed by the prime contractor shall be specifically addressed, key and non-key personnel shall be clearly identified when work is performed by a subcontractor and key and non-key personnel performing the tasks shall be identified.

children.title: The status of all assigned deliverables
children.content: including title, CDRL number, due date, date delivered, Contractor point of contact and title of deliverable(s) shall be included.

children.title: Cumulative list of all deliverable items
children.content: The report for each contract period shall include a cumulative list of all deliverable items provided.
